rule: Fit/report LCDM, wCDM, CPL, C0_frozen_benchmark, and C1_parent_locked_memory together.
pass_condition: all usable or explicitly failed with same optimizer diagnostics
fail_condition: MTS-only diagnostics or missing flexible baselines

rule: Report SH0ES and no-SH0ES separately; never merge them into one support sentence.
pass_condition: local-H0 pressure cannot carry the evidence label
fail_condition: claim depends on local-H0 branch alone

rule: Report SN, BAO quantity, H(z), growth, CMB distance-prior components separately.
fail_condition: single aggregate chi2 hides where the model wins or loses

rule: Count every fitted calibration, shape, amplitude, and nuisance freedom consistently across branches.
pass_condition: AIC/BIC are honest enough to score a boxing-round decision
